summary: Alliance's official application page lists ALL18 as the current cohort with regular admission due July 22 and program start September 7, 2026. The official site describes a 10-week hybrid accelerator for crypto and AI startups with $500k funding, mentorship, credits/perks, NYC onboarding, remote programming, and NYC/online Demo Day.

proposed_event.name: Alliance DAO Accelerator ALL18
proposed_event.description: Crypto & AI accelerator offering $500k funding, mentorship, NYC onboarding and a remote program.

dates.date_range_text: ALL18 regular admission deadline July 22, 2026; program starts September 7, 2026. Format is 2 weeks in New York City, then 8 weeks remote, with Demo Day in week 10.

sources.title: Accelerator Application | Alliance
sources.supports: Official ALL18 application page lists Early Admission closed May 30, Regular Admission July 22, interview invites within 72 hours, program start September 7, and in-person onboarding in New York City, United States.

sources.title: Alliance | Crypto & AI Accelerator
sources.supports: Official site describes Alliance as an accelerator and founder community for crypto and AI startups, with a 2-week New York City onboarding, 8-week remote program, week-10 Demo Day in New York City/online, $500k funding, mentorship, and credits/perks.

notes: The official pages do not state a timezone for the July 22 deadline or September 7 start date, so dates.timezone is null.
The program end date and exact Demo Day date are not published; program_end and demo_day are null.
Application close year is interpreted as 2026 because the official site states ALL18 is the next cohort starting September 7, 2026 and today is 2026-06-09.
